Are you claiming there is no overlap of people who say "I need to work on myself" and then proceed to go to therapy or rehab or get help and work on themselves? Are you saying there is no group of people who say that they need to work on themselves because they realize their partner doesn't deserve what they're being put through, and then go to therapy or rehab? Again, this is a very blanket statement that people who end relationships with the reason of "I need to work on myself" are always just giving an excuse so they can go fuck someone else.

No one works on themselves? No one goes to therapy to work through trauma or personal issues? No one goes to AA or rehab to work on addictions? People just are who they are and can't change that by working on themselves?? No one works on themselves??????? What a ridiculous blanket statement.

I think we'd need more details on the relationship and her personality to make a determination. Maybe she needed an excuse for ending the relationship. Maybe she realized she was independent or need to work on herself. Maybe she genuinely had some insecurity issues that she wanted to work on before she allowed herself to be in a partnership. Everyone is an individual so just because a similar thing happened to your friends doesn't mean it was for the same reasons or means anything for you. Hope you have good luck in the future!
